technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals present, but price remains below all key moving averages with bearish MACD and weak trend structure—high false-signal risk in downtrend.

fundamental.summary: EW shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 59 days present material event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral overall setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (315.36) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings in 59 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period), StochRSI bullish cross, and Supertrend flip combined with fear-zone sentiment (34/100) create textbook contrarian reversal setup near support at 89.43.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish MACD, weak trend structure (ADX not trending), inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (315.36), and zero fundamental conviction make this a high-probability false-signal trap in active downtrend.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and StochRSI cross present textbook reversal setup at support, but price remains structurally trapped below all major moving averages with bearish MACD and weak trend confirmation—false-signal risk is prohibitively high in active downtrend.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (315.36), and macro recession signals create hostile environment for mean-reversion trades; earnings in 59 days add material event risk that could gap through support.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 19 positions in Health Care sector (7.7% of portfolio); adding EW increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress without fundamental conviction to justify it.
